fullContentHtml:
UPPSC Computer Assistant Typing Test Result 2026 – Out - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the Typing Test Result for the post of Computer Assistant. This recruitment was released for 13 posts. Applications for the UPPSC Computer Assistant Recruitment 2025 were accepted from July 01, 2025, to August 01, 2025. The Typing Test was conducted on 18 August 2026. Candidates can download their UPPSC Computer Assistant Typing Test Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 July 2025
  • Last Date : 01 August 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 August 2025
  • Correction Last Date : 08 August 2025
  • Exam Date : 06 February 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 27 January 2026
  • Result : 13 March 2026
  • Typing Test Date : 18 August 2026
  • Typing Test Admit Card : Available
  • Typing Test Result : 01 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 105/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 65/-
  • PH : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Important Links

  • UPPSC Computer Assistant Recruitment 2025 : Educational Qualification Candidates who have passed their 12th Intermediate level of Examination / Equivalent Examination with O Level Exam Passed from recognized board / Institute will be eligible for this post. All candidates must read the official information completely before applying.
